headline: Touchdown for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a short pass to T.Kelce who caught it in the end zone for a touchdown, which is worth 6 points.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to T.Kelce.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs and increases their chance of winning by 6 percentage points. It puts the team in a strong position as they now lead the game.
pop_culture: After T.Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season, Taylor Swift celebrated in the suite by pointing to her wedding ring and calling him her husband.
